record.paper_title: Homogenization in mechanics. A survey of solved and open problems
record.original_question: How can homogenization be carried out for a periodic elastic composite medium containing frictional fissures beyond the known special case where the problem is two-dimensional, the fissure is a straight segment, and the fissure is either open at all points or closed at all points? The desired formulation should handle the non-uniqueness of quasi-static frictional contact and determine the local correction field and macroscopic stress from the history of the macroscopic displacement and any hidden sliding variable needed to describe relative lip motion.

evidence.quote: only solved in the two-dimensional case

artifact.status_search_result: A 2013 paper by Cioranescu, Damlamian, and Orlik treats homogenization via periodic unfolding with contact on cracks that are either entirely open or entirely closed, consistent with the special case mentioned. Subsequent work addresses stability/bifurcation in self-contact and computational homogenization with XFEM for cracked SVEs, but no rigorous general homogenization result for periodic elastic composites with curved fissures undergoing mixed open/closed Coulomb-frictional contact in three dimensions appears to be available; the problem is presented as open.

status_evidence.title: Homogenization via unfolding in periodic elasticity with contact on closed and open cracks
status_evidence.snippet: Treats elasticity with ε-periodic microstructure and contact on cracks under Signorini and Tresca-friction conditions, with cracks treated as either open or closed.
status_evidence.claim: Existing rigorous homogenization results in this setting are restricted to the special case of cracks that are uniformly open or uniformly closed.

status_evidence.title: A study of stability and bifurcation in micro-cracked periodic elastic composites including self-contact
status_evidence.snippet: Analyzes quasi-static equilibrium paths of periodic composites with micro-cracks in frictionless self-contact, focusing on stability and bifurcation rather than general homogenization.
status_evidence.claim: The general homogenization with full frictional contact and mixed open/closed states is not established.

status_evidence.title: Computational homogenization of microfractured continua using weakly periodic boundary conditions
status_evidence.snippet: Develops computational (not analytic) homogenization for media with stationary cracks via XFEM on SVEs.
status_evidence.claim: Available approaches in three dimensions and for curved fissures are computational rather than yielding closed-form homogenized constitutive laws.
